blocks.text: Tablet Package include: 1* 10 inch tablet pc, 1* Bluetooth Keyboard, 1* Bluetooth mouse, 1* Standable Protective Case, 1* flexible stylus, 1*Type C Cable.

items: 【Portable 2-in-1 Tablet PC】 2 IN 1 Tablet has passed GMS certification,tablet comes with bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse and foldable protective case, it can flexibly turn tablet into a laptop mode or computer mode. By connecting the keyboard and wireless mouse through Bluetooth, it becomes an ultra portable mini laptop, perfect for home, school, and office use. Enables you to work and learn efficiently and quickly handle daily tasks, offers you limitless features and capabilities

【Faster Responsive Performance】Our 10 inch tablet equipped with stable Android 15.0 system, 5G Wifi-6, Bluetooth, 8GB RAM(Includes 6GB of virtual memory) and 64GB ROM, with microSD card slot which can expanded up to 1024GB, more app, songs, videos and pictures can be saved right on your tablet.

【10.1" HD Screen and HD lens】The stunning 10 IN eye protection full screen has a larger visual area and a wider visual field, adopts a 1280*800 IPS HD touch screen, whether you play games, watch movies, read, take notes and work, it can bring you immersive visual. The tablet 10 inch equipped with a 8MP rear camera with auto focus and flash, shooting is equally clear during the day and night, Capture Your Wonderful Moments. The 2MP front camera bring excellent clarity during video calls enjoyment

【Long Battery Life and Dual Speaker】Android 15 tablets by a 6000mAh battery, durable battery life ensures long-term use, allowing you to study, work, and play all day without interruption. Accompanying you from day to night can bring about 6-8 hours of regular operation, 10 IN Tablet 3D stereo surround effect, bringing clear, full, and detailed sensations. Intelligent switching of sound effects in multiple scenes such as music, movies, games, and calls, make your immerse yourself in entertainment.

【Perfect Gift】This is the perfect gift and after-sales service for all age groups. This tablet is suitable for elderly people to watch TV videos, for children to play games and learn, for office workers to work and participate in video conferences, for work and entertainment, and is the best companion.
